### Intro

Hi!

I am a Aditya, a Research Engineer working on Robot Learning at Neuracore, we use MuJoCo for our examples in [neuracore](https://github.com/NeuracoreAI/neuracore). 

We support aarch64 for our package. Yesterday, on 5 October 2026, mujoco 3.15 was released without python 3.11 wheels for aarch64, and users on 3.11 haven't been able to install our library. Could you please upload the aarch32 wheel for python 3.11?

Here you can find that there's no wheel for aarch64 python 3.11 wheen mujoco 3.15 - https://pypi.org/project/mujoco/?filename=aarch64#files

### My setup

Ubuntu 24.04 aarch64

### What's happening? What did you expect?

Not able to install mujoco 3.15 on aarch64 on python 3.11.


### Steps for reproduction

Run this snippet on a ARM64 Linux (Ubuntu 24.04) machine: 

```python
uv tool install -p 3.11 neuracore[examples]
```
